title: Elevate UI Performance: Master CSS 'font-display' for Optimal Web Font Loading
tweet: Boost your web's UI performance and user experience! Learn how to master CSS 'font-display' for smart web font loading strategies. Say goodbye to FOUT/FOIT. #CSSTypography #WebFonts #UIDesign #Performance
tip: To significantly enhance the user experience and perceived performance of your UI, strategically implement the 'font-display' property in your CSS @font-face rules. This controls how web fonts are loaded and displayed, mitigating issues like Flash of Unstyled Text (FOUT) or Flash of Invisible Text (FOIT), ensuring a smoother visual experience during page load. Opt for 'font-display: swap' for critical body text to prioritize content readability, or 'font-display: fallback' for less critical elements to balance performance and visual integrity.
